title: 第一卷 第21章 魔潮爆发第一卷 第22章 叶芷萱再现
content_zh:
林间战斗激烈。
聂远等三人联手绞杀，勉勉强强杀死一只三阶的大地暴熊。
这时候，三人回过头来，全部陷入了呆滞状态。
在他们不远处，叶寒静静擦拭着手上的鲜血，整理着衣衫，而地上则是躺着四道大地暴熊尸体。
“你是怪物吧？”
何青峰不禁失声。
这是人能干出的事？
他们辛辛苦苦猎杀一只大地暴熊，想着今天怎么能逃过这一劫，结果叶寒直接将剩下的四只全杀了？
“神力境的战力！”
“叶寒，你居然有神力境战力，你这种绝世天才，怎么会和我们杂役弟子在一起？”
沉寂数个呼吸后，聂远突然开口。
“我不是天才！”
叶寒摇摇头。
真正的天才，十二三岁已能聚元八重、九重，到了叶寒这个年纪，已能踏入神力境。
现在轮回书院的外门弟子中就有那种人。
“你这还不是天才？我们三个加起来，恐怕不够你一拳的吧？”
何青峰古怪地看着叶寒，那意思是你别矫情。
“太虚秘录上介绍过，当初风无量，十二岁已达到聚元九重，十六岁成年之时，已达到神力境八重。
包括外门弟子中，一些神力境的天才，其实年龄和我们也在伯仲之间而已。”
叶寒开口。

“好了，将熊胆挖掘出来，我们继续寻找大地暴熊。”
叶寒紧接着道。
五个熊胆很快就被几人收起来，然后几人在山岭中继续前行。
“又是尸体？”
片刻之后，几人盯着眼前的大地，都露出惊愕之色。
他们看到有身穿轮回书院弟子服饰的尸体躺在那里，看起来触目惊心，大约死去不超过两三天。
不远处还有其他人的尸体，但并不像是自相残杀，他们的死状都很凄惨，甚至血肉都少了一部分。
“是被魔人猎杀的！”
叶寒凝视着不远处，在那里还有几具魔人尸体。
“不对啊，妖魔岭中虽然魔人不少，但都生存在深处妖魔大峡谷一带。”
聂远道：“在外围，几乎是不可能有魔人踪迹的。”
“不错，按照我知晓的，我们来到此地猎杀妖兽和魔人，那些魔人虽然残暴，但也不敢轻易来到外围。”
content_en:
The battle raged in the forest.
Nie Yuan and the other three people worked together to strangle and barely managed to kill a third-level earth violent bear.
At this time, the three of them turned around and fell into a sluggish state.
Not far away from them, Ye Han quietly wiped the blood from his hands and arranged his clothes, while four earth-violent bear corpses were lying on the ground.
"Are you a monster?"
He Qingfeng couldn't help but lost his voice.
Is this something a human can do?
They worked hard to hunt down a violent earth bear, thinking how they could escape this disaster today, but in the end, Ye Han killed all the remaining four?
"Combat power in the realm of divine power!"
"Ye Han, you actually have divine power. How come you, a peerless genius like you, are with our handyman disciples?"
After a few breaths of silence, Nie Yuan suddenly spoke.
"I'm not a genius!"
Ye Han shook his head.
A true genius can already gather the eighth and ninth levels of energy at the age of twelve or thirteen, and by the age of Ye Han, he can already enter the realm of divine power.
There are people like that among the outer disciples of Samsara Academy now.
"Aren't you a genius? The three of us combined are probably not enough for you to punch, right?"
He Qingfeng looked at Ye Han strangely, that means don't be pretentious.
"It was introduced in the Taixu Secret Record that Feng Wuliang had reached the ninth level of Juyuan at the age of twelve, and had reached the eighth level of divine power when he reached adulthood at the age of sixteen.
Including the outer disciples, some geniuses in the realm of divine power are actually about the same age as us. "
Ye Han spoke.
"Okay, let's dig out the bear's bile and let's continue looking for the Geomancer Bear."
Ye Han continued.
The five bear gall bladders were quickly collected by several people, and then they continued to move forward in the mountains.
"A corpse again?"
After a while, several people stared at the ground in front of them, all showing shock.
They saw a corpse lying there wearing the attire of a disciple of Samsara Academy. It looked shocking. He had probably been dead for no more than two or three days.
There were other corpses not far away, but it didn't look like they were killing each other. Their deaths were miserable, and even part of their flesh and blood was missing.
"He was hunted by a demon!"
Ye Han stared at not far away, where there were several demon corpses.
"That's not right. Although there are many demons in Demon Ridge, they all live in the deep Demon Valley."
Nie Yuandao: "In the periphery, it is almost impossible to find traces of demons."
"Yes, according to what I know, we came here to hunt monsters and demons. Although those demons are cruel, they don't dare to come to the outside easily."
